preview.tournamentOverview: Presidents Cup at Medinah CC (No. 3) is a team match-play event that rewards balanced ball-striking and short-game control. The course places heavy emphasis on strokes-gained around-the-green 1%) and total strokes-gained 9%), with approach play 5%) and off-the-tee 8%) also critical. This international team showdown carries extra weight as players compete for national pride and future captaincy considerations.
preview.modelExplainer: Our model weights SG Total at 9% and SG Around-the-Green at 1%, making these the two most influential categories. Approach play 5%) and off-the-tee 8%) follow closely, while putting 9%) and accuracy metrics 8% driving accuracy, 0% bogey avoidance) carry less weight. This weighting rewards players who gain strokes through ball-striking and short-game recovery rather than pure putting or accuracy.
preview.pickApproach: We tier players by combining tournament-specific rankings with power rankings, prioritizing those who excel in the heavily weighted SG Total and SG Around-the-Green categories. Top-tier selections focus on players ranked inside the top 10 in both systems with strong approach and around-the-green numbers. Secondary picks target players with SG Total above 2 who show positive marks in the key weighted stats despite lower overall power rankings.

article.title: Presidents Cup 2026: Model Ranks Scheffler, Lee, Morikawa as Top Targets at Medinah
article.dek: Three players with top-10 model ranks and zero tracked rounds since the Open lead the data-driven card at Medinah CC (No. 3).
article.introduction: The Presidents Cup model at Medinah CC (No. 3) places Scottie Scheffler at rank 1 with 868 SG Total, Min Woo Lee at rank 2 with 693 SG Total, and Collin Morikawa at rank 3 with 53 SG Total. All three players carry zero tracked rounds since the Open and sit inside the FedExCup top 50. Course weights emphasize SG Total 9%), SG Around-the-Green 1%), and SG Approach 5%).

sections.heading: Tournament Overview
sections.body: The Presidents Cup model ranks 24 players for Medinah CC (No. 3) using a 9% SG Total weight, 1% SG Around-the-Green weight, and 5% SG Approach weight. Scottie Scheffler, Min Woo Lee, and Collin Morikawa occupy the top three model positions with SG Total marks of 868, 693, and 53 respectively.

sections.heading: Course Fit
sections.body: Medinah CC (No. 3) weights place the heaviest emphasis on SG Total 9%), SG Around-the-Green 1%), and SG Approach 5%). Scheffler's 868 SG Total and 618 SG Around-the-Green align with the top two weighted categories. Lee's 675 SG Off-the-Tee and 457 SG Putting also map to the course weights.

sections.heading: Recent Form
sections.body: The three selections share zero tracked rounds since the Open. Scheffler's model rank 1 and power rank 1 rest on season-long SG Total of 868. Lee's model rank 2 and power rank 8 rest on season-long SG Total of 693. Morikawa's model rank 3 and power rank 9 rest on season-long SG Total of 53.

sections.heading: Post-Open Workload
sections.body: All three players record NO_TRACKED_ROUNDS since the Open. The model does not treat zero tracked rounds as rest; it simply notes the absence of data in the tracked events.

sections.heading: FedExCup Motivation
sections.body: Scheffler enters at FedExCup rank 1, Lee at rank 21, and Morikawa at rank 7. All three sit inside the top 50 and therefore carry SAFE_TOP_50 status for the Presidents Cup.

sections.heading: Crossover Research Angles
sections.body: Each player combines a top-10 model rank with a skipped Scottish Open and zero tracked rounds since the Open. Scheffler, Lee, and Morikawa share this exact profile.

sections.heading: Outright Targets
sections.body: Scheffler (model rank 1, power rank 1, 868 SG Total) and Lee (model rank 2, power rank 8, 693 SG Total) form the outright tier. Both players also carry the shared research profile of zero tracked rounds and SAFE_TOP_50 FedExCup status.

sections.heading: Top-10 Targets
sections.body: Scheffler, Lee, and Morikawa (model rank 3, 53 SG Total, 066 SG Approach) comprise the top-10 tier. Morikawa's SG Approach leads the group and aligns with the 5% course weight.

sections.heading: Top-20 Targets
sections.body: The same three players—Scheffler, Lee, and Morikawa—anchor the top-20 tier. Their model ranks (1-3) and SG Total marks 868, 693, 53) sit well clear of the next group.

sections.heading: Data Limitations

sections.heading: Final Betting Card
sections.body: Tier 1 (model-supported): Scottie Scheffler outright, top-5, top-10, top-20. Tier 2 (model-supported): Min Woo Lee outright, top-5, top-10, top-20. Tier 3 (model-supported): Collin Morikawa top-10, top-20.

article.conclusion: Tier 1: Scottie Scheffler across all markets. Tier 2: Min Woo Lee across all markets. Tier 3: Collin Morikawa top-10 and top-20 only.
